collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager practicing a song by the stream is joined by an off-key frog: sing a duet, or find a quieter spot.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been practicing a song by the stream in the evenings, softly, where nobody can hear. Every time (subject.he/she) holds a long note, a frog nearby holds one too. Lower. Louder. Slightly out of tune. Every single time.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) leans into it. For a while it's (subject) and the frog, verse after verse. Then a second frog joins in. Then a third. Soon the whole bank is croaking along and (subject) is conducting them with a stick. (friend), passing by, stops in the middle of the path with (friend.his/her) mouth open.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) moves upstream. The frog follows, hopping from stone to stone. Upstream there is another frog, who also sings. (subject) moves again. There are frogs everywhere. In the end (subject.he/she) goes home and practices inside the hut. When (subject.he/she) opens the door the next morning, a frog is sitting on the doorstep.
